premise: The first snowflakes fall so quietly that the forest has to whisper to hear them, and by evening everything wears a white hat.
inspiration: Hush lullabies and Andersen's quiet wonder at winter, with a counting beginning (one, two, three) that grows into a blanket.
lesson: Quiet things are worth listening for.

en-US.title: The First Snow
en-US.text: [softly] The sky is quiet and white today. A little {bird:enter} bird flutters down onto a branch and {bird:pulse} looks up. Then… {canvas:snow 0.5 45s} {sfx:hush} one snowflake. Two snowflakes. {all:face surprised} Three! The bird {bird:tint #BFE3FF} shivers. Along hops a {rabbit:enter} rabbit, {sfx:crunch} crunch, crunch, leaving tiny footprints. Then his long ears {rabbit:live hold} shoot straight up, and he listens, very still. [whispers] The snow falls so softly that the whole forest has to whisper to hear it. The bird {bird:face happy} smiles. He {bird:live} puffs up round as a ball, tips back his head and sings a soft snowy song. The {pinecone:enter} pinecone comes rolling by, and a snowflake lands on her {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:sparkle} nose. The rabbit {rabbit:live resume} relaxes, finds one last green clover, and {rabbit:face happy} nibbles it. {canvas:sunset 0.5 16s} [slowly] By evening, the pinecone {pinecone:glow #EAF6FF} wears a white hat, and the whole forest is {all:face sleeping} tucked under a white, white blanket. [whispers] Shhh. Listen. That's the sound of snow.

es-ES.title: La primera nieve
es-ES.text: [softly] Hoy el cielo está callado y blanco. Un {bird:enter} pajarito baja revoloteando a una rama y {bird:pulse} mira hacia arriba. Y entonces… {canvas:snow 0.5 45s} {sfx:hush} un copo de nieve. Dos copos. {all:face surprised} ¡Tres! El pajarito {bird:tint #BFE3FF} tirita. Llega un {rabbit:enter} conejo dando saltitos, {sfx:crunch} cric, cric, y deja huellas chiquititas. Entonces sus orejas largas {rabbit:live hold} se ponen tiesas, y escucha, muy quieto. [whispers] La nieve cae tan suave que todo el bosque tiene que susurrar para oírla. El pajarito {bird:face happy} sonríe. {bird:live} Se ahueca redondo como una bola, echa la cabeza atrás y canta una canción de nieve. La {pinecone:enter} piña llega rodando, y un copo se le posa en la {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:sparkle} nariz. El conejo {rabbit:live resume} se relaja, encuentra un último trébol verde y {rabbit:face happy} lo mordisquea. {canvas:sunset 0.5 16s} [slowly] Al atardecer, la piña {pinecone:glow #EAF6FF} lleva un gorro blanco, y todo el bosque está {all:face sleeping} arropado bajo una manta blanca, muy blanca. [whispers] Chsss. Escuchad. Así suena la nieve.
